name: f6-temporal-dynamics-person-evolution
description: For one real subject, evaluates this folder's own RMS-distance CDIx shape (already validated by F4_CURV_DEPTH_KPI_ORIG_CHARACTERISTICS) once per real session instead of once, turning a sequence of real points into a trajectory: CDIx(t_s) per session, DELTA_CDI and a discrete velocity approximation between real, adjacent sessions. Reuses an already-built GDX_HNF_CDI_REFERENCE_SET (never builds its own reference) and never attributes a real CDIx change to a cause (CAUSAL_CLAIM_MADE is schema-CHECKed to always be 0).
